summary: Reasoning trail is a foldable record of how an agent worked through a task: its plan, its notes, the sources it used and the edits it made. It sits in a chat thread under a header that reads "Reasoning" with a running clock, then "Reasoned for Ns" once the agent is done.
use: When people want to check how the agent reached its answer before they trust it.
When the agent follows a plan and you want each step to show as done, in progress or next.
When the agent changed files and people should see the removed and added lines in place.
When the reasoning should stay out of the way until someone opens it.
features: It shows one of four views, picked with `view`: plan, notes, sources or edits. A view with nothing in it falls back to the first one that has content.
Plan steps are done (a check and their `detail`), now (a pulse and "Working") or next (a grey dot and "Next").
Notes are plain lines, sources are file and link chips with tooltips, and edits list each file with its removed and added lines.
While `running` is true, the header shimmers and counts seconds, unless you pass `seconds`. `title` replaces the default header text.

Clicking the header, or pressing Enter or Space on it, folds the trail open or shut, controlled with `open` and `onOpenChange` or left to the component. Switching views grows or shrinks the open trail to its new height and plays the entrance again.
It sits flat in a chat thread by default, and `bare={false}` gives it a card of its own.
a11y: The header is a button with `aria-expanded`, which follows every click, Enter and Space.
When folded, the body is `inert` and `aria-hidden`, so its chips leave the tab order.
The thinking glyph and status dots are decorative and hidden from screen readers.

faq.q: Does the trail come with Plan, Notes, Sources and Edits tabs?
faq.a: No. The component shows whichever view you pass in `view`, and you supply the switcher. The designme.dev demo puts a segmented control under it and keeps the room of the tallest view, so the control stays put as you switch.

faq.q: How do I show progress through the plan?
faq.a: Pass `plan` as steps with `state` set to 'done', 'now' or 'next', and update them from your own state as the agent moves on. Set `running` to false when it finishes.

faq.q: What does an edit look like?
faq.a: An edit has a `file`, an optional `detail` like "2 lines", and `removed` and `added` arrays of lines. Removed lines are shown first, then added ones, under the file name.
